decision.title: The shared IR is internal, tree-walking and ANF-like

item.p: Internal, in src/ir_internal.h, not a public header. XPath, XQuery and XSLT front ends are all in this repository, so nothing outside needs to produce IR; a public IR would join the frozen ABI before XQuery and XSLT have tested it. Hosts extend sxml through function bodies () and the resolver, not through IR. If a later need appears (an external front end, a persisted compiled form), a decision publishes a versioned copy.

Shape, after Xee's xee-ir (): expressions whose operands are atoms (a constant or a variable slot), with let bindings for intermediate values; branches, loop bodies and function bodies are nested expressions. The focus is not implicit state: map, filter, quantified, sort and path-step nodes bind the context item, position and size as ordinary variables, so closures capture them like any variable and XPDY0002 is a static or dynamic check on an unbound slot. Variables are resolved to frame slots during lowering; function definitions carry their capture list. Node-construction, try/catch and template-rule nodes are reserved for XQuery and XSLT (XSLT rules lower to IR functions plus a rule table, as in Xee).
Evaluation walks the IR (no bytecode: PLAN.md non-goal), with evaluation depth bounded so deep recursion returns a limit status.

Optimizer seam: src/ir_pass_internal.h declares a pass as an IR-to-IR function over a compiled unit, run in a fixed list between lowering and evaluation. Phase 1 has only a verifier pass; rewrites (constant folding, type-based simplification) come later as new passes, each with tests that compare results with and without it.
